color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Page background #fcfcfc luminance 252, confirmed light register.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at 0.06em on all heading levels (h1–h4). Satoshi replaced with Space Grotesk (Google Fonts CDN) — geometric grotesque matching Satoshi's structural DNA for tight-tracking heading performance.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling slower ×1.3. All transition durations scaled up for more languid, deliberate pacing: 0.3s→0.39s, 1s→1.3s, 0.1s→0.13s, 0.2s→0.26s, 0.4s→0.52s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened 15% for a more editorial feel. 1436px → 1220px. Padding unchanged at 77px inline.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5. Hero padding expanded from 34.56px/43.2px to 51.84px/64.8px. All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement. Added outlineWidth: 2px + outlineOffset: 2px to buttons and inputs for keyboard accessibility.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links set to 0.08em. Font family changed from 'Neue Montreal' (proprietary, not in assembled type system) to 'inherit' — resolves to Space Grotesk from assembled typography.
nav-system.consistencyFix: Check C flagged nav fontFamily 'Neue Montreal' not in assembled type system. Fixed to 'inherit'.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift applied to Typography System paragraph — added specific detail about physical materiality of 0.06em letter-spacing as the tactile sensation of a print compositor's deliberate kerning decisions. concept_by_video.md generated fresh.
